# `fnox plugin update`

- **Usage:** `fnox plugin update [NAMES]…`
- **Aliases:** `upgrade`

Update installed plugins to their declared source

## Arguments

- **`[NAMES]…`** — Plugins to update; updates all installed plugins when omitted

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Checks out each plugin's declared ref, or its remote's default branch when no ref is declared. Without arguments, updates every installed plugin; linked plugins are skipped.

```sh
fnox plugin update
fnox plugin update corp
```
